name: 1641 Indiana Avenue — Stone-front brick dwelling (district draft; refined by T-1946)

grade.why: Known from maps or written records; no picture of it has been found.

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: Robinson 1886 draws the house and the 1904 Blue Book lists its household. The 1911 sheet shows it gone; when it went is not read.

placement.position_note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 26.250, v -6.750 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the plate: the plate's fit is 4.54 m RMS, the weakest of the four T-1250 fits (a photographed atlas page, rotated and curved toward the binding), plus about a pixel (0.35 m) of reading. Rotation 179.446 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.
placement.symbolic_location: 1641 S. Indiana Avenue, parcel indiana_1641 (data/street_grid/1904.json), east side of Indiana Avenue, the background behind Prairie Avenue: Indiana Avenue's east frontage, 16th to 18th Street, and East Sixteenth Street's row at 209-217 (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 20, checked lot by lot against Robinson 1886 plate 10).

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: RECONSTRUCTED: Robinson's atlas prints no storey count, and the 1911 sheet, which would, no longer draws the house. Three storeys is the block face's own median: the 1911 sheet prints 3B, 3B, 2½B, 2B and 3½B on the Indiana and 16th Street houses drafted beside it.

construction.note: Robinson 1886 colours the house pink, the plate's brick, with a darker strip along its Indiana face, the plate's mark for a stone front, as on 1615 and 1703.

parts.from: r1886-1641-f p1 (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 97% of its fill
r1886-1641-f p1 (main, brick), rectangle 2 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 97% of its fill

draft_plan.note: Rectangles fitted inside the traced parts by the rules' fit (cell 0.25 m, at most 3 a part, to 90% cover): r1886-1641-f p1 (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 97% of its fill; r1886-1641-f p1 (main, brick), rectangle 2 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 97% of its fill. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'Stone-front' overlaid with the frontage row: The 1886 stone-front brick house at 1641: the brick family's hip over three storeys behind a stone face, every face closed; its stable on the alley is the T-3019 draft's. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 536827097 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %. Liberty L-draft-indiana-1904-lots-3068.

draft.note: The draft's own provenance: the pass that wrote it, the rows it read and the tickets that replace it attribute by attribute under this id.

function.note: The 1911 sheet draws no house at 1641. T-3068 stands the 1886 house for 1904 because the Blue Book lists the Cummings household at 1641 in every edition from 1890 to 1908, the 1904 edition included; residence is attested by that listing and the house's form is the plate's.

citations.citation: Robinson, E. Robinson's Atlas of the City of Chicago. New York: E. Robinson, 1886. Plate 10, "Part of 2.39.14 Assessors Div."
what_it_supplies: The water's edge beside the Illinois Central from above 16th Street to 18th, as of 1886 -- a bound, from before, on the 1904 edge
Lot and subdivision lines, and the outlines of the houses at 1609-1611 and 1620 Prairie that Glessner House names as standing in 1904 and gone by 1911
what_it_does_not_supply: Street widths: its bands are not drawn to the widths it prints (Prairie printed 66, drawn about 55 ft)
Anything as of 1904 on its own authority

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3068, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1946 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the Robinson 1886 plate 10 reading (r1886-1641-f: the outline in the plate's pixels, carried by its T-1250 fit) (r1886-1641-f), the T-3019 census (r1886-1641-f) and the T-1837 register row frontage-20w-1641 (Stone-front brick dwelling); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-indiana-1904-lots-3068).
